authority: Function view must be produced from a semantically verified LLVM/candidate module; no origin/ABI attestation is conferred by this view.

function_fields.signature: admitted normalized execution/nominal signature digest32 hex
function_fields.blocks: block vector; order normalized by reachable CFG
function_fields.block_addresses: false; computed-address extension requires separate exact canonical graph policy

block_fields.term: operation with explicit successor role vector

phi_fields.incoming: vector of exact {block:u32,value:u32}; canonical order by remapped predecessor

semantic_node.literal: null, exact bool, integer or strict Unicode string; numeric constants are never renamed
semantic_node.map: exact verified semantic fields sorted by UTF8 key; reserved debug field is nonsemantic debug only
semantic_node.reference: exact {$ref:kind,id:value}; kind value/block usesu32 rewritten local IDs; type/symbol/region uses admitted normalized digest32

normalization.blocks: BFS from entry using lexically sorted unique successor roles; switch case roles encode fixed-width unsigned big-endian bitpatterns; unreachable blocks omitted only without block addresses
normalization.values: parameters first, then phi, operation and terminator output declarations in BFS block order
normalization.phis: all predecessor/value references rewritten; unreachable predecessor entries omitted; source SSA/edge validity preverified
normalization.constants: all bits, semantic flags, types, effects, call/journal/EH attributes and symbolic relocation addends preserved
normalization.output: UTF8 JSON, sorted map keys, no whitespace, no NaN/float, strict Unicode; source debug omitted

module_hash.records: IDs1..10 ascending, each u16 little-endianID + u64 little-endian length + canonical payload
module_hash.self: zero only schema-selected32-byte own identity field in section2; references use self tag; do not pattern-replace equal user bytes

comdat.key: namespace+linkage group name, never content digest
comdat.function_extent: byte length of canonical comparison-view UTF8 body; recomputed
comdat.data_tls_extent: admitted allocation byte extent; fixed vs selected-definition extent policy explicitly bound by ABI
comdat.any: first input ordinal whole group; no body equality; O0/O2 permitted
comdat.largest: largest key-member portable extent, tie first input ordinal
comdat.samesize: key-member extent equal, choose first input ordinal
comdat.noduplicates: project policy rejects duplicate group key
comdat.nodeduplicate: LLVM policy retains all group instances then normal symbol collision rules
comdat.mixed_selection: any+largest resolves largest as pinned LLVM LinkModules; every other mismatch rejects
comdat.membership: any/largest/samesize may differ; compare ABI/kind/extent policy for every common member across all inputs, key symbol identical; exactmatch requires full set; select whole group, missing needed selected member rejects during subsequent binding

deployment.key_view: resolved logical module family; minor version separate; candidate adapter supplies namespaced family/major identity
deployment.dependency_id: consumer-local declaration ID, resolved explicitly to provider private export ID
deployment.publication: validate all actual content hashes and declaration/ABI/version maps first; atomically publish complete SCC before tokens/constructors
deployment.source_identity: public namespace/name/kind/source_linkage plus admitted normalized execution/source-boundary identities; exclude deployment family/artifact/generation/private numeric IDs; locals use smir.unit.<INT011UID> namespace
deployment.runtime_authority: actual admitted artifact+generation+lease; source type equality never authorizes a call or object
deployment.prototype_assumption: artifact hashes in this resolved view have already been verified from required canonical bytes by integrator
deployment.source_linkage: explicit none/c/cpp on symbol boundary; declaration/provider agree, never infer from spelling/type language
deployment.nominal_identity_view: admission-normalized C-boundary identity for c symbols, strict source identity for cpp/none; actual root Cdata callback is mandatory, this model does not derive or certify it
deployment.abi_signature: null for execution-only/data/TLS; sourcefunction c/cpp requires admitted normalized full call-plan digest (this/VTT/sret/byval/varargs/classification/noundef), separately compared from execution/type nominal; actual R034 wire opt entity_ref uses ABI actual comparator before normalization

candidate_projection.precondition: actual complete semantic admission against the same immutable roots; projection confers no admission
candidate_projection.schema: schema/execution/candidate.json exact current record fields; option absent=null/present={some:value}
candidate_projection.types: actual Types.digest recomputes execution graph; target.signature is execution type; outer function.abi_signature uses signature namespace
candidate_projection.recipes: actual admitted adapter_recipe map keyed qualified reference; capture.parameter -> ordered recipe.params ordinal
candidate_projection.ids: BFS successor roles; params/phis/operations/invoke normal results then unwind exception declarations; region membership chain then first explicit region/handler use, parents first; remaining regions depth/parent/semantic-content order; handler source order; actions first region use then semantic content; no numeric constant rewriting
candidate_projection.region_reference: SHA256(UTF8 SMIR-COMPARE-REGION-V1 + NUL + canonical full EH semantic node + canonical region ID u32LE)
diagnostics: unknown record fields or unreachable CFG reject
candidate_projection.complexity: O(N^2 + I) conservative worst-case time, O(N) retained output space excluding provider identity work; N record/reference/capture size, I identity work. Reused action content participates in region ordering keys; admitted region depth <=64. Region reference hash shares full-EH prefix state.
candidate_projection.evidence: conformance/llvm/candidate-comparison.json passes actual SEM verify, nonmonotone alpha renaming and independent runtime function_body equality; no full ten-root proof
